his_words: this AI slop amalgamation creepypasta horror Crashbox HBO series vibe... make some really good elements or direction for art for shit like that, for real

the_one_face.rule: every haunted face in act one is this one face; smooth on a screen, printed with his paper grain on paper

rules.one_at_a_time: never two wrongness elements on one screen
rules.never_announced: no sound sting, no zoom, no glow, no text pointing at it (the bible rules 2 and 3)
rules.purple: none on any element; purple first appears at the threshold, on the hatch only (the purple law)
rules.placement: the coordinator hands each element to the lane that owns its screen; DIRECTION places nothing

beats.B0: THE FIRST HOURS: nothing. No wrongness before the first town is done (nothing in the first sixty seconds, the second votes).
beats.B1: A DETAIL: things you could miss. At most one a day of game time, about one in five days.
beats.B2: IT CHANGED: the same thing, different when you come back. About one in three days.
beats.B3: IT KNOWS YOU: your company is in it (your feed, your loading screen, your walls). About one a day.
beats.B4: IT IS IN THE CAMP: where you sleep and where you fight. Up to two a day.
beats.THRESHOLD: THE END OF ACT ONE: purple appears for the first time, on the hatch only. The faces line up: it was one face, and it was a machine.
